en:hang.enDefinition: To be or remain suspended. · To float, as if suspended. · To veer in one direction. · To rebound unexpectedly or unusually slowly, due to backward spin on the ball or imperfections of the ground.
en:hang.deDefinition: etwas hängen, aufhängen: etwas an einem festen Punkt nach unten baumelnd befestigen; etwas an eine bestimmte Stelle hängen · hängen: an einem festen Punkt nach unten baumelnd befestigt sein · jemanden (oder sich) erhängen: durch Erhängen töten · durch Erhängen sterben

en:meeting.enDefinition: The act of persons or things that meet. · A gathering of persons for a purpose; an assembly. · The people at such a gathering. · An encounter between people, even accidental.

en:till.enDefinition: Until; to, up to; as late as (a given time). · Before (a certain time or event). · So that (something may happen).

en:others.enDefinition: See other (determiner) below. · Second. · Alien. · Different.

en:catch.enDefinition: The act of seizing or capturing. · The act of catching an object in motion, especially a ball. · The act of noticing, understanding or hearing. · The game of catching a ball.

en:follow.enDefinition: To go after; to pursue; to move behind in the same path or direction, especially with the intent of catching. · To go or come after in a sequence. · To carry out (orders, instructions, etc.). · To live one's life according to (religion, teachings, etc).
en:follow.deDefinition: jemandem folgen (‚hinterhergehen‘) · jemanden verfolgen (beobachten, beschatten, überwachen) · (dem Verlauf/der Richtung) einer Straße folgen · folgen; zeitlich: anschließend (auf etwas) folgen

en:sex.enDefinition: A category into which sexually-reproducing organisms are divided on the basis of their reproductive roles in their species; the system of such categories, which can differ by organism or by taxonomic branch. · Another category, especially of humans and especially based on sexuality or gender roles. · The members of such a category, taken collectively. · The distinction and relation between these categories, especially in humans; gender.

en:lie.enDefinition: To rest in a horizontal position on a surface. · To be placed or situated. · To abide; to remain for a longer or shorter time; to be in a certain state or condition. · Used with in: to be or exist; to belong or pertain; to have an abiding place; to consist.

en:evening.enDefinition: time of day between the approximate time of midwinter dusk and midnight
en:evening.pairedSense: time of day between the approximate time of midwinter dusk and midnight

en:master.enDefinition: Someone who has control over something or someone. · The owner of an animal or slave. · The captain of a merchant ship; a master mariner. · Someone who employs others.
en:master.deDefinition: Meister, Herr · Master (akademischer Grad) · Person mit zweitem akademischem Grad

en:known.enDefinition: Identified as a specific type; famous, renowned. · Accepted, familiar, researched.

en:dream.enDefinition: Imaginary events seen in the mind while sleeping. · A hope or wish. · A visionary scheme; a wild conceit; an idle fancy.

en:write.enDefinition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate. · To be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.). · To compose and send written information (to). · To compose and send (written information or a written message, e.g. a letter) to.
en:write.deDefinition: (Symbole, Buchstaben, Wörter) auf einer Fläche zeichnen, formen, zum Beispiel mit einem Bleistift · (einen Brief, ein Buch, ein Testament) verfassen · schriftlich ausdrücken, berichten · einen Brief schreiben; (mit jemandem) schriftlich kommunizieren

en:million.enDefinition: The cardinal number 1 000 000: 10⁶; a thousand thousand (1,000²). · An unspecified very large number.

en:voice.enDefinition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character. · Sound made through vibration of the vocal cords; sonant, or intonated, utterance; tone; — distinguished from mere breath sound as heard in whispering and voiceless consonants. · The tone or sound emitted by an object. · The faculty or power of utterance.
en:voice.deDefinition: individuelle Lautwiedergabe eines Menschen · Genus Verbi, grammatische Kategorie von Verben

en:rather.definition: oldukça, çok · (would rather) tercih etmek, yeğlemek · bir ifadeyi yumuşatmak, emir veriyormuş veya zorluyormuş gibi görünmemek için fiilerin önüne eklenir. · aksine
en:rather.enDefinition: Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than) · Used to introduce a contradiction; on the contrary. · Introducing a qualification or clarification; more precisely. (Now usually preceded by or.) · Somewhat, quite; to an unexpected degree.

en:felt.enDefinition: A cloth or stuff made of matted fibres of wool, or wool and fur, fulled or wrought into a compact substance by rolling and pressure, with lees or size, without spinning or weaving. · A hat made of felt. · A felt-tip pen.

en:sign.enDefinition: a fact that shows that something exists or may happen
en:sign.pairedSense: a fact that shows that something exists or may happen

en:bet.enDefinition: A wager, an agreement between two parties that a stake (usually money) will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event). · A candidate (for elections and pageants) or competitor (in multinational sports). · Indicating a degree of certainty, or that something can be relied upon.

en:longer.enDefinition: having much distance from one point to another
en:longer.pairedSense: having much distance from one point to another

en:calling.enDefinition: To request, summon, or beckon. · To cry or shout. · To utter in a loud or distinct voice. · To contact by telephone.

en:worked.enDefinition: intransitive: to do a specific task
en:worked.pairedSense: intransitive: to do a specific task

en:quiet.enDefinition: With little or no sound; free of disturbing noise. · Having little motion or activity; calm. · Not busy, of low quantity. · Not talking much or not talking loudly; reserved.

en:looked.deDefinition: sehen · schauen · blicken · hinschauen · hinsehen · gucken

en:less.enDefinition: Used for constructing syntactic diminutive comparatives of adjectives and adverbs. · To a smaller extent or degree.

en:pull.enDefinition: To apply a force to (an object) so that it comes toward the person or thing applying the force. · To gather with the hand, or by drawing toward oneself; to pluck or pick (flowers, fruit, etc.). · To attract or net; to pull in. · To persuade (someone) to have sex with one.
en:pull.deDefinition: mit Anwendung von Kraft auf sich zu bewegen; (etwas) ziehen · etwas aus oder von etwas entnehmen, das dort befestigt oder angewachsen war

en:beat.enDefinition: A stroke; a blow. · A pulsation or throb. · A pulse on the beat level, the metric level at which pulses are heard as the basic unit. Thus a beat is the basic time unit of a piece. · A rhythm.

en:careful.enDefinition: Taking care; attentive to potential danger, error or harm; cautious. · Conscientious and painstaking; meticulous.
en:careful.deDefinition: vorsichtig, achtsam · bedacht, achtsam, umsichtig · sorgfältig, genau, gründlich · sparsam

en:coffee.enDefinition: A beverage made by infusing the beans of the coffee plant in hot water. · A serving of this beverage. · The seeds of the plant used to make coffee, called ‘beans’ due to their shape. · The powder made by roasting and grinding the seeds.

en:return.enDefinition: The act of returning. · A return ticket. · An item that is returned, e.g. due to a defect. · An answer.

en:secret.enDefinition: A piece of knowledge that is hidden and intended to be kept hidden. · The key or principle by which something is made clear; the knack. · Something not understood or known. · Private seclusion.

en:date.definition: hurma · karşı cinsten biri ile randevu, buluşma · randevuya çıkılan kişi, kız veya erkek arkadaş · gün, ay, yıl v.s. şeklinde tarih
en:date.enDefinition: The fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera, somewhat in the shape of an olive, containing a soft, sweet pulp and enclosing a hard kernel. · The date palm. · The anus.
en:date.deDefinition: Datum, Zeitpunkt, (Kalender)tag · Termin · Verabredung, Treffen, Stelldichein · Begleiter, Begleitung, Partner

en:fall.enDefinition: The act of moving to a lower position under the effect of gravity. · A reduction in quantity, pitch, etc. · A waterfall. · A loss of greatness or status.

en:given.enDefinition: To transfer one's possession or holding of (something) to (someone). · To make a present or gift of. · To pledge. · To provide (something) to (someone), to allow or afford.

en:ooh.enDefinition: An expression of surprise. · An expression of awe. · A sound made to imitate a ghost. · An expression of affection.

en:straight.enDefinition: Not crooked, curly, or bent; having a constant direction throughout its length. · Direct, undeviating. · Perfectly horizontal or vertical; not diagonal or oblique. · Describing the bat as held so as not to incline to either side; on, or near a line running between the two wickets.
en:straight.deDefinition: etwas ist gerade, hat keine Kurven oder Biegungen

en:takes.enDefinition: to get into one's hands or control
en:takes.pairedSense: to get into one's hands or control

en:song.enDefinition: A musical composition with lyrics for voice or voices, performed by singing. · Any musical composition. · Poetical composition; poetry; verse. · The act or art of singing.
en:song.deDefinition: das Lied, das Gesangstück/Gesangsstück, der Gesang, der Sang · musikalischer Ton eines Tieres, dessen Stimme die Menschen melodiös finden, das Zirpen, der Vogelgesang, Walgesang · etwas, das nur ein bisschen kostet · das Musikstück

en:future.definition: gelecek, encam, istikbal, ati · gelecek · gelecek zaman
en:future.enDefinition: The time ahead; those moments yet to be experienced. · Something that will happen in moments yet to come. · Goodness in what is yet to come. Something to look forward to. · The likely prospects for or fate of someone or something in time to come.

en:loved.definition: sevgi · sevi · aşk · emre · muhabbet · sevda
en:loved.deDefinition: Liebe · Zuneigung · Minne · Liäbi · Liebi · Liab

en:road.enDefinition: A way used for travelling between places, originally one wide enough to allow foot passengers and horses to travel, now (US) usually one surfaced with asphalt or concrete and designed to accommodate many vehicles travelling in both directions. In the UK both senses are heard: a country road is the same as a country lane. · Roads in general as a means of travel, especially by motor vehicle. · A path chosen, as in life or career. · An underground tunnel in a mine.

en:calm.enDefinition: Peaceful, quiet, especially free from anger and anxiety. · Free of noise and disturbance. · with few or no waves on the surface; not rippled. · Without wind or storm.

en:mad.definition: deli, çılgın · (konuşma dili) çok kızgın · kuduz
en:mad.enDefinition: Insane; crazy; mentally deranged. · Angry; annoyed. · Used litotically to indicate satisfaction or approval. · Bizarre; incredible.

en:turned.enDefinition: In the pattern "X turned Y", indicates that someone has turned (changed) from X into Y.

en:drop.enDefinition: small quantity of liquid, just large enough to hold its own round shape through surface tension
en:drop.pairedSense: small quantity of liquid, just large enough to hold its own round shape through surface tension

en:ladies.enDefinition: An initial hand consisting of a pair of queens.
en:ladies.deDefinition: höfliche Bezeichnung weiblicher Person(en) · informelle oder brüske Anrede einer einzelnen Frau ohne ihren Namen · formelle Anrede einer Angehörigen des britischen Adels oder des House of Commons, gefolgt von ihrem Namen · Versal, die Mutter seines Gründers

en:learn.definition: öğrenmek · ders almak (kötü bir olaydan) · ders çalışmak · haber almak
en:learn.enDefinition: To acquire, or attempt to acquire knowledge or an ability to do something. · To attend a course or other educational activity. · To gain knowledge from a bad experience so as to improve. · To study.

en:step.enDefinition: intransitive: to move the foot in walking
en:step.pairedSense: intransitive: to move the foot in walking

en:absolutely.definition: kayıtsız şartsız, koşulsuz, mutlak, sınırsız, tam bir şekilde · hiçbir, katiyetle, kesinlikle (genellikle olumsuz kullanılır) · tabii ki, mutlaka (onay belirtir)
en:absolutely.enDefinition: In an absolute or unconditional manner; utterly, positively, wholly. · Independently; viewed without relation to other things or factors. · As an intensive: extremely, very, indeed.

en:early.enDefinition: At a time in advance of the usual or expected event. · Arriving a time before expected; sooner than on time. · After but close to the start of a period of time. · In the starting hours of the day.
en:early.deDefinition: zeitig, eher ankommen · zeitig, eher als erwartet oder normal

en:piece.enDefinition: A part of a larger whole, usually in such a form that it is able to be separated from other parts. · A single item belonging to a class of similar items. · One of the figures used in playing chess, specifically a higher-value figure as distinguished from a pawn; (by extension) those with which draughts, backgammon, and other similar board games are played. · A coin, especially one valued at less than the principal unit of currency.

en:yesterday.enDefinition: The day immediately before today; one day ago. · The past, often in terms of being outdated.
en:yesterday.deDefinition: der gestrige Tag; Gestern · vergangene Zeiten; die frühere, damalige Zeit

en:throw.enDefinition: To hurl; to release (an object) with some force from one’s hands, an apparatus, etc. so that it moves rapidly through the air. · To eject or cause to fall off. · To move to another position or condition; to displace. · To make (a pot) by shaping clay as it turns on a wheel.
en:throw.deDefinition: etwas mit der Hand durch die Luft schleudern; werfen

en:picture.enDefinition: A representation of anything (as a person, a landscape, a building) upon canvas, paper, or other surface, by drawing, painting, printing, photography, etc. · An image; a representation as in the imagination. · A painting. · A photograph.
en:picture.deDefinition: Bild, Zeichnung, Foto, Gemälde · Beschreibung · Kinofilm · Fernsehbild

en:land.enDefinition: To descend to a surface, especially from the air. · To come into rest. · To arrive on land, especially a shore or dock, from a body of water. · To bring to land.

en:wonder.enDefinition: something that causes amazement or awe, a marvel
en:wonder.pairedSense: something that causes amazement or awe, a marvel

en:questions.enDefinition: A worded or expressed sentence, phrase, or only a word on its own, which asks for information, a reply, or a response; an interrogative. · A subject or topic for consideration or investigation. · A doubt or challenge about the truth, accuracy, or validity of a matter. · A proposal to a meeting as a topic for deliberation.

en:speaking.enDefinition: Used in speaking. · Expressive; eloquent. · Involving speaking. · Having the ability of speech.

en:worth.enDefinition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for. · Deserving of. · Making a fair equivalent of, repaying or compensating.

en:darling.enDefinition: Often used as an affectionate term of address: a person who is very dear to one. · A person who is kind, sweet, etc., and thus lovable; a pet, a sweetheart; also, an animal or thing which is cute and lovable. · A favourite. · The favourite child in a family.

en:dude.enDefinition: A man, generally a younger man. · A term of address for someone, often but not exclusively a man, particularly when hailing, cautioning them or offering advice. · A tourist. · A birder who has expensive clothing and equipment, but scant knowledge of birds, their fieldmarks, habits, etc.

en:giving.enDefinition: To transfer one's possession or holding of (something) to (someone). · To make a present or gift of. · To pledge. · To provide (something) to (someone), to allow or afford.

en:president.enDefinition: The head of state of a republic, sometimes also the head of government as well, particularly (US politics) the head of the executive branch of the federal government of the United States of America. · A person presiding over a corporation, usually an executive overseeing daily operations under a chief executive officer but sometimes a separate position held by a CEO. · A person presiding over a meeting. · A person presiding over a dinner or similar informal conversation.

en:eye.enDefinition: An organ through which animals see (“perceive surroundings via light”). · The visual sense. · The iris of the eye, being of a specified colour. · Attention, notice.
en:eye.deDefinition: Auge · das Nadelöhr · das Auge: Zentrum eines Wirbelsturms

en:quick.enDefinition: Moving with speed, rapidity or swiftness, or capable of doing so; rapid; fast. · Occurring in a short time; happening or done rapidly. · Lively, fast-thinking, witty, intelligent. · Mentally agile, alert, perceptive.

en:moving.enDefinition: That moves or move. · Causing or evoking deep emotions.

en:strong.enDefinition: Capable of producing great physical force. · Capable of withstanding great physical force. · Possessing power, might, or strength. · Determined; unyielding.

en:none.enDefinition: Not any of a given number or group. · No one, nobody. · No person.

en:amazing.enDefinition: present participle and gerund of amaze
en:amazing.deDefinition: Partizip Präsens (present participle) des Verbs amaze

en:ones.enDefinition: A single. · Being a preeminent example. · Being an unknown person with the specified name; see also “a certain”.

en:works.enDefinition: plural of work in its countable senses

en:act.definition: hareket, eylem · kanun, yasa · rol yapma, oyun, numara · bölüm, perde, sahne
en:act.enDefinition: Something done, a deed. · Something done once and for all, as distinguished from a work. · A product of a legislative body, a statute. · (In the United States) A legislative proposal, a bill that has not yet become law.

en:weird.enDefinition: Having an unusually strange character or behaviour. · Deviating from the normal; bizarre. · Relating to weird fiction ("a macabre subgenre of speculative fiction"). · Belonging, pertaining, or related to fate, destiny, or to the Fates; able to influence fate.

en:law.enDefinition: body of rules established in a community by its authorities
en:law.pairedSense: body of rules established in a community by its authorities

en:worried.enDefinition: Thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen; feeling afraid and unhappy.

en:report.enDefinition: To relate details of (an event or incident); to recount, describe (something). · To repeat (something one has heard), to retell; to pass on, convey (a message, information etc.). · To notify someone of (particular intelligence, suspicions, illegality, misconduct etc.); to make notification to relevant authorities; to submit a formal report of. · To make a formal statement, especially of complaint, about (someone).

en:goodbye.enDefinition: Farewell; a formula used to another person or persons when the speaker, writer, or person addressed is departing.

en:choice.enDefinition: An option; a decision; an opportunity to choose or select something. · The power to choose. · One selection or preference; that which is chosen or decided; the outcome of a decision. · Anything that can be chosen.

en:happening.enDefinition: To occur or take place. · To do or occur by chance or unexpectedly. · To encounter by chance. · To become popular or trendy.
en:happening.deDefinition: vor sich gehen: geschehen, passieren, sich ereignen · (mit to) das Schicksal von etwas oder jemandem sein: werden (aus), zustoßen; etwas zufällig tun oder sein · (mit on oder upon) jemandem oder etwas zufällig begegnen: stoßen (auf), finden · (mit dem Subjekt it) zufällig oder unerwartet geschehen

en:chief.enDefinition: The leader or head of a tribe, organisation, business unit, or other group. · Headship, the status of being a chief or leader. · The top part of a shield or escutcheon; more specifically, an ordinary consisting of the upper part of the field cut off by a horizontal line, generally occupying the top third. · The principal part or top of anything.
